name: Marlin
description: Marlin is a firmware for RepRap 3D printers optimized for both 8 and 32 bit microcontrollers.  Marlin supports all common platforms.   Many commercial 3D printers come with Marlin installed.  Check with your vendor if you need source code for your specific machine.

latest_release.body:
This is a minor release patching miscellaneous issues.

Example Configurations for many machines are posted at:
https://github.com/MarlinFirmware/Configurations/tree/release-2.1.2.10

### Changes

- 🔨 Update frameworks for STM32H7 (lts-2.1.2) (#28826)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MarlinFirmware/Marlin/compare/2.1.2.9...2.1.2.10
